title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit logging for region pinning
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Customers and SRE have requested stronger guarantees around KMS key residency when RBAC v2 grants access to encrypted resources. Previously we audited region mismatches but did not enforce them. This PR adds an opt-in enforce mode for KMS region residency and enhances audit logging to always record the KMS key region, the evaluated residency policy, and the decision path. Motivation: reduce accidental cross-region key usage, meet regulatory data residency requirements, and give platform operators clear audit trails. Summary of changes: 1) rbac v2 policy evaluator: add kms_residency constraint support and short-circuit enforcement path when policy requires same-region; 2) KMS integration: propagate key metadata (region, key-id, alias) to policy evaluation and audit events; 3) audit logging: new structured audit fields (kms_key_region,kms_key_id,policy_residency_decision,policy_rule_id) emitted to central audit pipeline; 4) config/feature flag: feature.rbac.v2.kms_residency.mode with values [audit,enforce] and rollout-safe default = audit; 5) DB schema: add resources.kms_residency_required boolean + migration script to backfill from existing policy sets; 6) API/CLI: new admin endpoints to preview enforcement-impact and a migration guide; 7) tests: unit, integration with local KMS emulator, and end-to-end harness updates. Rollout plan: Phase 1 (audit-only): merged feature behind flag; internal smoke for Dedicated clusters; Phase 2 (preview/enforce opt-in): enable enforce for a small set of customers; Phase 3 (gradual enforcement): default to enforce in new accounts and announce deprecation timeline for audit-only mode. Migration and rollback: Backfill migration marks resources that require residency; admins can revert feature flag to audit to roll back enforcement immediately. Performance: evaluation adds a KMS metadata lookup but is cached per-request using existing KV cache keys to keep added latency under 1ms for cached keys. Security review: KMS metadata is treated as non-sensitive for policy decisions; full key material is never surfaced. Checklist: - [x] Policy evaluator change implemented - [x] KMS metadata propagation added - [x] Audit event fields implemented and forwarded - [x] DB migration script + dry-run validated - [x] Integration tests against KMS emulator - [x] SRE runbook and rollout docs written - [x] Linear ticket updates and release notes added Risks & mitigation: false positives during migration (mitigated via audit-only phase), increased cardinality in audit logs (mitigated by sampling + dedicated retention), private deployment upgrade complexity documented for on-prem/KMS-HSM customers. Related: ENG-4231, SEC-781, SUP-2048.
